description.value:
Your body and mind resist harm with uncanny consistency. Increase your Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you have advantage on a saving throw using Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma, you may reroll one of the two dice a single time.

system.requirements: 4th level; Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma 13.
